_meta.what: The single authoritative product-type keyword list used to decide whether two products are the same kind of thing for matching purposes (Supply Disruption Tracker alternatives and the Compare tool's product-type narrowing). Also carries the generic-name override map and the cannula override's disqualifier list.
_meta.warning: EDITING THIS FILE CHANGES LIVE MEMBER-FACING PRODUCT MATCHING ON BOTH SIDES. sdt_match.py reads its own copy directly (this file is the reference the two are kept in step with — see the orchestrator's wiring there); comparison.js fetches this file at runtime from GitHub. A bad edit here is a bad edit on the live Hub within the daily cache window, not a draft. This is the maintained 04/09/2026 list (167 entries) — do not revert to the pre-04/09 147-entry list that comparison.js carried as a literal before this file existed; that drift is exactly what this file exists to close. See verify.py's check_product_types() for the gate that enforces it stays closed.
